summary: Append a node, moving it from any previous parent, and return that same node.

semantics.document_fragment: appends fragment children, empties fragment, but returns fragment
semantics.validation: enforce node-tree hierarchy constraints before/while insertion as DOM specifies

caveats: List.Add is insufficient: reparenting, DocumentFragment expansion, hierarchy errors, and node identity matter.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § Node.appendChild / pre-insert

tests.name: moves existing node and returns identity
fragment children move
tests.input: const f=document.createDocumentFragment(); f.append('a','b'); const r=document.body.appendChild(f); console.log(r===f,f.childNodes.length);
